# Agência de Marketing - Admin Panel Project

## Project Overview
Admin panel for the marketing agency's recommendation and rewards system for the companies it serves.

## Features
- Authentication system with login page
- Dashboard for managing partner companies
- Client management for each partner company
- Link generation for referral system

## Technology Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- React

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions
- Keep components modular and reusable
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling
